Charming older home with lots of character features feels much larger than the reported square footage. Solarium located in center of home for a lovely area for your plants with skylights and a shade to close off the living area if need be. Gas Fireplace All appliances, except microwave, including washer and dryer Extra cabinets in double garage for additional storage. Shed off to the side of the house for your garden tools - some are even provided. Tenant is responsible for all yard care. Tiered landscaping in the back provides a wonderful private back patio. Master bedroom has private access to back patio. Kitchen is separate from living area, but has a great corner window and extra large sink. Gas range. Skylights in breakfast nook. Formal dining room separates the kitchen from the living room. Double sinks in master bath and skylight is located there too for additional lighting. Walk in closet. Each guest bedroom in ample in size. Large patio area with short brick wall provides wonderful area for additional enjoyment of the outdoors. PLEASE - Owner prefers NO PETS! NO SMOKING OF ANY KIND ALLOWED IN, ON OR AROUND THE PROPERTY. If you like unique floor plans, this is a must see. Viewing scheduled ONLY AFTER APPLICATIONS ARE RECEIVED. You are welcome to drive by the property, but do NOT disturb the current tenants. No application fee charged until you are ready to be processed. Application Fee is $50.00 for every person over 18, and each person must submit an application. Security Deposit is subject to change. GFA heating and Central A/C Tenant is responsible for all utilities. To apply: www.hummingbirdpropertymanagement.com. Click on Apply Now and carefully read the criteria to determine your own ability to be approved. Questions: Call 555-555-0101
